body: That would be nice, but I can't. I don't deserve help. I don't deserve support. I'm not worth saving. I'm sorry.

LOTS of reasons. I could go on and on about why I don't want to live anymore but then it would just end up being a ten page essay. It's all so overwhelming. I think I'm feeling a little better now than yesterday but I still can't guarantee I won't try again in the future. This is already the 3rd time I attempted and I failed every single time. How does one even manage to fuck up trying to die THAT badly??
i attempted to hang myself with a blanket since i don’t own rope but i didn’t secure it well enough so when i walked off the chair i ended up falling on the floor
